newsitem.title: USA: Disney nearing Latam pay-TV deal - report.
newsitem.headline: Disney nearing Latam pay-TV deal - report.

text.p: Walt Disney Co is close to signing its first pay-TV distribution deal in Latin America, with HBO Ole, a joint venture between Time Warner, Sony Corp and Venezuelan investors, Daily Variety reported Wednesday.
Disney is the last major Hollywood studio to make such a deal, which is "95 percent likely", the trade paper said, quoting a source in the pay-TV industry.
The pact calls for distribution of the Disney Channel and a licensing deal for the studio's live-action films, the article said.
The paper reported that Disney executives met with representative from Warner, Sony and the Venezuelan partners Tuesday in Los Angeles.
A Disney spokeswoman said reporting the deal was "very premature" but did not deny that discussions between Disney and HBO Ole were at an advanced stage, Variety said.
The Latin American accord would be similar to Disney's 10-year pay-TV deal with Germany's Kirch Group, which also includes an option to distribute a German satellite version of the Disney Channel.
